title: I Have Overcome the World
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: Jesus told his disciples the future: trouble, opposition, and victory. Sin, suffering and hatred cannot stop the plan of God.
exhortation: We would all love to know the future and see around the corner of time. That is exactly what Jesus does for his disciples here. He is about to tell them he is going away, and he knows they will be tempted to fear and discouragement. So he tells them the plan: he is going to the Father, and he will send the Holy Spirit to empower them. He tells them there will be hatred and opposition from their own people and from the world. And he tells them they will win.

We win because we are in Christ. We win despite the hatred of the world, the lies and attacks of the enemy, and even our own sin. Our enemies can't stop the plan of Jesus. It's as good as done. But it isn't easy, and it can be discouraging at times. Jesus knew Peter would deny him. He knew how dark and hard the path would be.

And yet look at what Peter writes after going through it, knowing more opposition and even death lay ahead: "Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial when it comes upon you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you. But rejoice insofar as you share Christ's sufferings, that you may also rejoice and be glad when his glory is revealed. If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests upon you." Peter got it.
Are you discouraged this morning? Remember that sin, suffering, hatred and opposition cannot stop the plan of God. We have a glorious future in Christ.
prayer: Lord, if it weren't for your grace, we would be utterly lost. And yet you came down, left your glory to seek and save the lost, and shed your blood so that we could come near and be restored to you. As we gaze at your cross, fill our hearts with faith for the path ahead.

Thank you for telling us the future. There will be difficulty and trials: struggles with sin and opposition from the world, even from family and friends. And yet you are with us in the power of your Holy Spirit to guide us through and bring us to the glorious end, seeing you face to face. What a glorious future. We pray this in your precious name. Amen.
